root_idea.summary: The root has a principal sense of strength, intensity, and freedom from weakness, with an associated image of the strands or twists of a rope. It also has a distinct branch relating to barren, uninhabited land and consequent want.
root_idea.development: The strength branch yields قُوَّةٌ and قَوِيٌّ, while the separate قَوَاءٌ branch denotes an empty or barren land and develops into meanings of desolation and poverty. A rare isolated usage records اِقْتَوَى for partners successively raising the price of an item.

senses.definition: One who is in a barren land; hence, one left without provisions or in want.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic plural مُقْوِينَ, the word refers to people in the desert or barren open country, with the associated notion of lacking provisions.

senses.definition: Strong, powerful, and possessing substantial capacity or force.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of created beings or entities for ordinary strength and power, and of God as the All-Strong, whose power is unrestricted in relation to creation.

senses.definition: Strength or capacity available for action; physical power, general ability, or power attributed to God.
senses.usage_conditions: The capacity may belong to the body, a person or community, or divine power. Context can render it as strength, power, force, or firmness without requiring a separate lexical meaning.

senses.definition: Inner strength, resolve, or firmness of heart for receiving and carrying out a command.
senses.usage_conditions: In constructions such as taking a book or revelation بِقُوَّةٍ, the word denotes inward resolve rather than merely bodily force.

senses.definition: External means, forces, or resources by which one is strengthened or enabled to act.
senses.usage_conditions: This includes supporting people, troops, material resources, or other means relied upon for strength; it is distinct from strength inherent in the person or body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become strong, vigorous, robust, or sturdy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A basic Form I verbal use describing the acquisition or presence of strength.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be strong enough for or able to endure something; to prevail against it, or to prevail over a person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional عَلَى construction, used with travel, adversity, and similar objects or circumstances.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie with, contend with, or strive to surpass another in strength.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III reciprocal or competitive construction concerning superiority in strength.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a house to become empty, vacant, or unoccupied.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a dwelling that has been left without inhabitants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A barren, uninhabited, or desolate tract of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct lexical branch associated with the condition of an empty or uncultivated place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter barren country and, by extension, to be left without provisions or become poor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense develops from being in a desert or empty land to lacking sustenance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strengthen oneself, seek to acquire strength, or make oneself capable of enduring something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With مِنَ الشَّيْءِ بِقَوْمِهِ, it can mean to protect or support oneself against something through one's people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strength, power, potency, might, or force, including vigor in the body or intellect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical variant or related noun used for force or vigor in physical and intellectual contexts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single strand, twist, or yarn forming part of a rope, string, or thread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete technical sense referring to a distinct twisted portion of a larger cord or thread.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A faculty or perceptive capacity, such as the faculty by which the ear perceives sounds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical sense for an operative faculty or capacity in a bodily organ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Potential or virtual capacity: a state of being able or prepared to become or do something without its being actualized.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in contrast with بِالفِعْلِ, actuality; it can describe an existing but unused ability or a capacity to learn or develop one.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For partners or co-purchasers to raise their bids successively until an item's price reaches its highest point.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare, isolated usage recorded as departing from the principal strength and barren-land branches.
